title: STANDARD PRACTICES AIRFRAME - GENERAL

title: STANDARD PRACTICES AIRFRAME - GENERAL
question: How does the chapter's sectional organization assist maintenance personnel in quickly finding detailed information on topics such as material cautions, torque data, and safety procedures?

A brief definition of the subjects and sections incorporated in this chapter is as follows. (1) The section on Material and Tool Cautions describes general cautions and warnings applicable to maintenance on or around the airplane. (2) The section on Torque Data provides tables, formulas, requirements and torque limits for various type fasteners. (3) The section on Safetying describes the proper methods and use of safety wire/lockwire, cotter pins and lock clip installations. (4)  The section on Control Cables and Pulleys describes the construction, examination and storage of cable assemblies and pulleys. (5) The section on Solvents, Sealants and Adhesives provides the description and uses for solvents and cleaners; fuel, weather, pressure and high temperature sealing; and the application of adhesives and solvent bonding. (6) The section on Conversion Data contains information converting the more commonly used measuring units found in the Maintenance Manual.

question: Which section of the chapter provides guidance on the proper use of safety wire, cotter pins, and lock clips during aircraft maintenance?
answer: This chapter is divided into sections to aid maintenance personnel in locating information. Consulting the Table of Contents will further assist in locating a particular subject. A brief definition of the subjects and sections incorporated in this chapter is as follows. (1) The section on Material and Tool Cautions describes general cautions and warnings applicable to maintenance on or around the airplane. (2) The section on Torque Data provides tables, formulas, requirements and torque limits for various type fasteners. (3) The section on Safetying describes the proper methods and use of safety wire/lockwire, cotter pins and lock clip installations. (4)  The section on Control Cables and Pulleys describes the construction, examination and storage of cable assemblies and pulleys. (5) The section on Solvents, Sealants and Adhesives provides the description and uses for solvents and cleaners; fuel, weather, pressure and high temperature sealing; and the application of adhesives and solvent bonding. (6) The section on Conversion Data contains information converting the more commonly used measuring units found in the Maintenance Manual.
